featureType.name: Address_Number
featureType.title: Address Number
featureType.abstract: The street number of a property or home assigned by member municipalities for the delivery of 911 service and linked to an address location point on a property. This dataset is a combination of County and Municipal information and is updated daily directly from source municipal information correlated to property location data.
